examWarning.title: Academic Integrity & Anti-Cheating Protocol
examWarning.subtitle: Strict automated proctoring is active. Review and accept the regulations below before entering the examination room.
examWarning.rule1Desc: Leaving this tab, minimizing the browser, or switching windows is prohibited. Every tab switch or defocus event is recorded with an exact timestamp and reported directly to your professor.
examWarning.rule2Desc: PrintScreen, Windows Snipping Tool (Win + Shift + S), Mac screen captures, and external capture software trigger an instant blackout shield and log a cheating violation.
examWarning.rule3Desc: Your full name and student ID are dynamically stamped across all exam questions and answer options. Any external phone camera photograph will irrevocably identify your account.
examWarning.rule4Desc: All violation logs appear in real time in the professor's dashboard. Documented cheating attempts empower the instructor to immediately zero out the score and initiate disciplinary action.
examWarning.pledgeText: I solemnly pledge that I am taking this exam independently and honestly. I understand that any tab switches, screen captures, or unauthorized attempts are monitored and transmitted directly to the professor in real time.

antiScreenshot.warningMessage: Academic Integrity Shield: Screen capture and window switching are strictly prohibited. This incident has been logged and reported to your professor.
antiScreenshot.violationAlert: Cheating Violation #{{count}} Recorded & Sent to Professor!
